For over a decade, Hyundai has backed every car we’ve built with America’s Best Warranty and
this simple promise: Relax. We’ve got your back for the next 10 years or 100,000 miles. It’s a
commitment to customers that’s evolved into Hyundai Assurance, an umbrella of services that
includes 24/7 Roadside Assistance and more. Visit www.hyundaiassurance.com for details.

management, and community-level benefits for people near the forests.
